title: TETRA TECHNOLOGIES, INC. ANNOUNCES DATE FOR FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR 2025 EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL
summary: TETRA Technologies, Inc. ("TETRA" or the "Company") (NYSE:TTI) will release Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 results after the market close on Wednesday, February 25, 2026 and will host a conference call at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, February 26, 2026. Brady M. Murphy, President and CEO, and Elijio V. Serrano, Senior Vice President and CFO, will host the call. Conference call details: U.S. / International 1-646-307-1963; Canada 1-647-932-3411; Conference ID 5546853. Please visit the Events Presentations section of the TETRA Technologies website to listen to the call via live webcast. You can also pre-register for the conference call and obtain your dial in number and passcode by clicking here . A replay of the conference call will be available at 1-800-770-2030 ID 5546853# for thirty days following the conference call.
